business_summary: Shenzhen Jasic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of welding and cutting equipment in China and internationally. The company offers MIG/CO2 welding machines, digital pulse MIG welding machines, digital manual arc welding machines, digital full-function pulse argon arc welding machines, digital pulse AC/DC square wave argon arc welding machines, air plasma cutting machines, submerged arc welding machines, and handheld laser welding machines. It also provides welding and cutting accessories, covering multiple categories such as welding gun accessories, welding and cutting auxiliary materials, consumables and vulnerable parts, gas pressure regulators, and wires and cables and labor protection products; welding materials; and welding robots. Shenzhen Jasic Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
